reply: On an RTX 4090, the CUDA path speeds up MiMo's dense matmuls substantially: a 27136×6144 FP8 QKV decode call drops from 0.63 ms to 0.22 ms, and a 17-row prompt chunk from 9.2 ms to 1.7 ms, with wide kernels streaming each matrix once per 8 activation rows. End-to-end throughput for the Pro-MOPD checkpoint rises from about 1.79 tok/s to roughly 1.94 tok/s with lossless BF16

On an RTX 4090 (Windows, MiMo-V2.6-Pro), the engine reaches roughly 1.8–2.6 tok/s depending on configuration: the exact dense path with BF16 packing and expert streaming measures about 1.94 tok/s on the benchmark request, while speculative decoding with two MTP layers, prefetch cancellation, cache bonuses and a spinning OpenMP team pushes it to about 2.6 tok/s (2.2–2.3 tok/s across eight varied prompts).
